items.title: Binding of Isaac developer removes AI music from Repentance Plus
items.excerpt: Nicalis pulled AI-generated music from a GTA 6-themed mode in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ after players exposed it and review-bombed the update; creator Edmund McMillen says he 'had no idea' AI music had been used.

items.title: 'Woke Up to a S**t Show' — The Binding of Isaac Creator Says He Was Unaware of Now-Removed AI-Generated Music in Repentance+
items.excerpt: The Binding of Isaac developer Nicalis has removed undisclosed AI-generated music included in Repentance+ after backlash led to a review-bombing campaign on Steam and a response from the game's creator, Edmund McMillen.

items.title: The Binding of Isaac's new update was review-bombed over AI-generated music, and now it's been removed
items.excerpt: Nicalis has removed AI-generated music from The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ after players found it in a GTA 6-themed run.

items.title: Activision Patent Would Let AI NPCs Learn From Toxic COD Lobbies
